title: BASIC# Release Forensic Overlay
purpose: Verify a candidate changed-files payload over an accepted-base tree before project mutation, reporting every sealed validation inventory mismatch in one run.
required_checks: manifest target version matches BASIC# version
validation inventory target version matches BASIC# version
test-file inventory bytes and hashes match the overlaid candidate tree
required-tool inventory bytes and hashes match the overlaid candidate tree
sealed-artifact inventory bytes and hashes match the overlaid candidate tree
protected BSBC artifacts match the overlaid candidate tree
forbidden: mutating the active project before overlay inventory verification
stopping after the first sealed inventory mismatch
accepting a package whose inventory names files not present in the overlaid candidate tree
